statements.text: And I think it will be a big issue in communications networks generally because we are going to see AI deployed widely to support communications and, you know, cross the internet, and we want to make sure that it is being, again, deployed in a trustworthy way.
statements.context: House subcommittee hearing on the oversight and reauthorization of NTIA, where Rep. Cammack asks an NTIA witness about AI policy challenges.

statements.text: What benefits would there be from integrating AI into our Nation's energy sector? And would you want that sooner rather than later, and all the permitting to be reasonably quick?
statements.context: House Energy Subcommittee hearing on AI, energy, and American competitiveness.

statements.text: What happens if they intercept and take over our AI? What happens then?
statements.context: Remarks during a hearing on AI technology, human discovery, and American global competitiveness.
